f: Always launches the opponent toward the direction the attacker is facing, no matter where they're standing relative to the attacker.
b: Always launches the opponent away from the direction the attacker is facing - the opposite of 'f'.
lr: Launch direction depends on the opponent's position relative to the attacker: hit from the front, they're launched forward; hit from behind, the knockback flips backward - a 'reverse hit'.
pos: Launch direction depends on the opponent's position relative to the attacker: hit from the front, they're launched forward; hit from behind, the knockback flips backward - a 'reverse hit'.
part: Launch direction depends on the position of the specific hitbox part relative to the opponent, rather than the attacker's position as a whole.
speed: Launch direction follows the attacker's current movement instead of a fixed facing direction.
back_slash: A special case used by a small number of moves with their own reverse-facing hit behavior (e.g. Shulk's Back Slash).
